name: Rectangle Area Percentage: Dependent Tool Calls
description: Execute a tool, return its output to the model, then execute a dependent tool.

messages.content: First calculate the area of a rectangle with width 8 units and height 5 units. Wait for that tool result. Then calculate 10 percent of the returned area. Do not calculate the percentage yourself, and do not request both tool calls at once.

tools.name: calculate_rectangle_area
tools.description: Calculate the area of a rectangle.

tools.name: calculate_percentage
tools.description: Calculate a percentage of an amount.
